leadership.bio_am: የወጣቶችና የሴቶች የስራ እድል ፈጠራን፣ የቴክኒክና ሙያ ክህሎት ስልጠናዎችን፣ የጥቃቅንና አነስተኛ ኢንተርፕራይዞች ምስረታንና በጫቻ የኢንዱስትሪ ኮሪደር የስራ ትስስርን ይመራሉ።

leadership.bio_en: Oversees public sector human resource management, civil service reforms, institutional ethics, and merit-based staffing across all woreda sector offices.
leadership.bio_am: የመንግስት ሰራተኞች የሰው ሀብት አስተዳደርን፣ የሲቪል ሰርቪስ ሪፎርሞችን፣ የስነ-ምግባርና ሙያዊ ብቃትን፣ እንዲሁም በሁሉም የወረዳው ሴክተሮች ቀልጣፋ የአገልግሎት አሰጣጥ ስርአትን ይመራሉ።

leadership.bio_en: Spearheads commercial business registration, trade licensing, market price stabilization, and consumer protection across commercial centers.
leadership.bio_am: የንግድ ምዝገባና ፈቃድ አሰጣጥን፣ ህጋዊ የንግድ ስርአትን፣ የገበያ ዋጋ መረጋጋትን፣ የሸማቾች መብት ጥበቃንና የንግድ ሚዛን ፍተሻ ስራዎችን በበላይነት ይመራሉ።

leadership.bio_en: Leads agricultural transformation across all 19 rural kebeles, promoting certified wheat and malt barley cluster production and watershed conservation.
leadership.bio_am: በ19ኙም የገጠር ቀበሌዎች የግብርና ምርታማነትን ማሳደግ፣ የስንዴና የገብስ ክላስተር እርሻን ማስፋፋት፣ የተፋሰስ የአፈርና ውሃ ሀብት ጥበቃንና የአርሶ አደር ማሰልጠኛ ማዕከላትን ይመራሉ።

leadership.bio_en: Champions industrial and agro-processing investments along the Addis Ababa–Dessie economic artery, facilitating industrial land and one-stop support.
leadership.bio_am: በአዲስ አበባ-ደሴ ኮሪደር የኢንቨስትመንት መስህቦችን ማስተዋወቅ፣ የአግሮ-ኢንዱስትሪና ማኑፋክቸሪንግ ፕሮጀክቶችን መደገፍ፣ የኢንቨስትመንት መሬት ማመቻቸትና የአንድ መስኮት አገልግሎትን ይመራሉ።

leadership.title_en: Head of Peace and Security Office
leadership.bio_en: Directs district peace, crime prevention, highway security along the A2 corridor, community policing apparatus, and dispute reconciliation.
leadership.bio_am: የወረዳውን አስተማማኝ ሰላምና ጸጥታ ማስከበር፣ የማህበረሰብ አቀፍ ፖሊስ ስራዎችን፣ የወሳኝ ኮሪደሮች ደህንነት፣ የቀበሌዎች ሰላምና የግጭት መከላከል ስራዎችን ይመራሉ።

leadership.bio_en: Directs rural cadastral surveys, issuance of Second-Level Landholding Certificates (Green Book), boundary dispute adjudication, and land use zoning.
leadership.bio_am: የገጠር መሬት ይዞታ ምዝገባን፣ የሁለተኛ ደረጃ ይዞታ ደብተር (አረንጓዴ ደብተር) አሰጣጥን፣ የመሬት አጠቃቀም ፕላን፣ የይዞታ ወሰን ውዝግቦች እልባትና የአካባቢ ተፅዕኖ ግምገማን ይመራሉ።

leadership.bio_en: Administers 38 primary schools and 4 secondary schools, teacher professional development, school expansion projects, and regional exam administration.
leadership.bio_am: በወረዳው የሚገኙ 38 የአንደኛ ደረጃ እና 4 የሁለተኛ ደረጃ ት/ቤቶችን፣ የመምህራን ስልጠናና ምደባን፣ የትምህርት ጥራት ማሻሻልንና የፈተናዎች አስተዳደርን ይመራሉ።

leadership.title_en: Head of Planning and Development Office
leadership.bio_en: Guides multi-year socio-economic development planning, statistical registries, and monitoring and evaluation of capital public works.
leadership.bio_am: የወረዳውን ሁለንተናዊ የልማት እቅድ፣ የማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ስታቲስቲክስ መረጃዎች ምዝገባን፣ የመንግስት ፕሮጀክቶች ክትትልና ግምገማን ይመራሉ።

leadership.title_en: Head of Water and Energy Office
leadership.bio_en: Drives potable drinking water coverage, deep borehole drilling, gravity spring schemes, rural power grid expansion, and renewable energy adoption.
leadership.bio_am: የንጹህ መጠጥ ውሃ ተደራሽነትን ማስፋፋት፣ የጥልቅ ጉድጓድና የምንጭ ማጎልበት ስራዎችን፣ የገጠር ኤሌክትሪክ ሃይል ተደራሽነትንና ታዳሽ ሃይል ቴክኖሎጂዎችን ይመራሉ።

leadership.bio_en: Coordinates cabinet executive meetings, inter-office bureaucratic workflow, administrative protocol, citizen petitions desk, and institutional logistics.
leadership.bio_am: የወረዳውን ካቢኔ ሴክሬተሪያት ስራዎች፣ የቢሮዎች አስተዳደራዊ ቅንጅት፣ ይፋዊ ፕሮቶኮል፣ የህዝብ አቤቱታዎች አፈታትና የአስተዳደር ስራዎችን በኃላፊነት ያስተባብራሉ።

leadership.title_en: Head of Government Communication Affairs Office
leadership.bio_en: Directs public information dissemination, press releases, digital portals, civic awareness campaigns, and government transparency channels.
leadership.bio_am: የወረዳውን ይፋዊ የመንግስት መረጃዎችና ዜናዎች ስርጭት፣ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያና ዲጂታል ፖርታል ስራዎችን፣ የህዝብ ግንዛቤ ፈጠራ ዘመቻዎችንና የመንግስት ግልጽነትን ይመራሉ።

leadership.title_en: Head of Livestock Resource Development Office
leadership.bio_en: Spearheads dairy genetics upgrading, sheep breed improvements, veterinary clinical campaigns, nutritious fodder production, and poultry enterprise development.
leadership.bio_am: የእንስሳት ዝርያ ማሻሻልን (ሰው ሰራሽ ማዳቀል)፣ የወተትና የበግ እርባታን፣ የእንስሳት ክትባት ዘመቻዎችን፣ የመኖ ልማትንና የእንስሳት ህክምና ክሊኒኮችን በበላይነት ይመራሉ።

leadership.title_en: Head of Culture, Tourism and Sports Office
leadership.bio_en: Protects historical heritage sites, promotes highland ecotourism, fosters cultural values, and leads athletics and youth sports tournaments.
leadership.bio_am: የወረዳውን ታሪካዊ ቅርሶች መጠበቅ፣ የስነ-ምህዳር ቱሪዝምን ማስፋፋት፣ የባህላዊ እሴቶች ጥበቃን፣ የማህበረሰብ አትሌቲክስና የወጣቶች ስፖርታዊ ውድድሮችን ይመራሉ።

leadership.bio_en: Directs the preparation and administration of annual recurrent and capital budgets, public procurement integrity, and expenditure auditing compliance.
leadership.bio_am: የወረዳውን አመታዊ የካፒታልና የመደበኛ በጀት ዝግጅት፣ የመንግስት ግዥና ንብረት አስተዳደር ግልጽነትን፣ የፋይናንስ ኦዲት ቁጥጥርንና ጥብቅ የበጀት ዲሲፕሊንን ይመራሉ።

leadership.title_en: Head of Urban & Infrastructure Development Office
leadership.bio_en: Directs master plan execution for Chacha municipality, cobblestone and all-weather road infrastructure, municipal utility services, and urban sanitation.
leadership.bio_am: የጫቻ ከተማ ማስተር ፕላን አፈጻጸምን፣ የከተማ የኮብልስቶንና የአስፋልት መንገዶች ግንባታን፣ የማዘጋጃ ቤት አገልግሎቶችንና የመሰረተ ልማት ማስፋፊያ ስራዎችን ይመራሉ።

leadership.bio_en: Upholds constitutional rule of law, government legal advocacy, public prosecution, legal literacy campaigns for citizens, and inter-agency coordination.
leadership.bio_am: የህገ-መንግስቱንና የህግ የበላይነትን ማስከበር፣ የመንግስት የህግ ድጋፍና ክስ ማቅረብ፣ የዜጎች የህግ ግንዛቤ ማሳደግና ከፖሊስና ፍርድ ቤቶች ጋር የተቀናጀ የፍትሕ ስራን ይመራሉ።

leadership.title_en: Head of the Prosperity Party Office
leadership.bio_en: The top ruling party leader in the Woreda. He guides political strategy, party institutional builds, and coordinates party policies with district governance objectives.
leadership.bio_am: በወረዳው የገዥው ፓርቲ የበላይ መሪ ናቸው። የፖለቲካ ስትራቴጂዎችን፣ የፓርቲ መዋቅር ግንባታዎችን እና ርዕዮተ-ዓለም ስርጭቶችን የሚመሩ ሲሆን የፓርቲውን ፖሊሲዎች ከመንግስት የልማት ግቦች ጋር ያቀናጃሉ።

leadership.title_en: Head of the Political Sector (Prosperity Party)
leadership.bio_en: Operates under the Party Office, directly driving local political mobilization, community alignment forums, and structural public evaluation sessions.
leadership.bio_am: በፓርቲው ጽህፈት ቤት ስር በመሆን በአካባቢው የፖለቲካ ንቅናቄዎችን፣ ህዝባዊ የውይይት መድረኮችን፣ የአመራር አቅም ግንባታዎችን እና የወረዳውን ቀበሌዎች መዋቅራዊ ግምገማዎችን በኃላፊነት ያከናውናሉ።

services.title_am: የወሳኝ ኩነት ምዝገባ (ልደት፣ ጋብቻ፣ ፍቺ፣ ሞት)
services.cost_en: 50 ETB (Government stamp fee; free within 90 days of birth)
services.cost_am: 50 ብር (የቴምብር ክፍያ፤ በ90 ቀናት ውስጥ ለተወለዱ ነጻ)
services.description_en: Legal registration and issuance of official authenticated certificates for births, marriages, divorces, and deaths for residents of Angolela Tera Woreda, in accordance with federal vital event proclamation laws.
services.description_am: በአንጎለላ ጠራ ወረዳ ነዋሪ ለሆኑ ዜጎች በኢትዮጵያ የፌዴራል ወሳኝ ኩነት ምዝገባ ህግ መሰረት የልደት፣ ጋብቻ፣ ፍቺ እና የሞት ይፋዊ ህጋዊ የምስክር ወረቀት ምዝገባና አሰጣጥ።
requirements_en: Official Kebele Resident ID card of parents or applicant
Hospital/Health Center Birth Notification (for births)
Two witnesses with valid government IDs (for marriages/delayed registrations)
Official Medical Death Certificate or Kebele Confirmation (for deaths)
requirements_am: የወላጆች ወይም የአመልካች የቀበሌ የታደሰ መታወቂያ ካርድ
የህክምና ተቋም የልደት ማስታወቂያ ሰነድ (ለልደት ምዝገባ)
ሁለት ህጋዊ መታወቂያ ያላቸው ምስክሮች (ለጋብቻና ለዘገዩ ምዝገባዎች)
የህክምና ተቋም የሞት ማረጋገጫ ወይም የቀበሌ አስተዳደር ማረጋገጫ (ለሞት ምዝገባ)
steps_en: Step 1: Obtain a referral endorsement from your respective Kebele Administration
Step 2: Submit the completed vital event form with supporting documents at the Central Desk in Chacha
Step 3: Verification of records in the National Civil Registry Database
Step 4: Receive laminated official certificate bearing official seal and QR security verification
steps_am: ደረጃ 1፡ በነዋሪነት ከሚገኙበት ቀበሌ አስተዳደር የማረጋገጫ ደብዳቤ መያዝ
ደረጃ 2፡ የተሞላውን ማመልከቻ ሰነድ በጫቻ ማዕከላዊ የወሳኝ ኩነት መስኮት ማቅረብ
ደረጃ 3፡ በብሔራዊ የወሳኝ ኩነት መረጃ ቋት ላይ ትክክለኛነቱ ሲረጋገጥ ማጽደቅ
ደረጃ 4፡ ማህተም የተደረገበትንና የQR ኮድ ጥበቃ ያለውን ይፋዊ የምስክር ወረቀት መረከብ

content_en: The 6th Angolela Tera Woreda Council has concluded its high-level ordinary session following two days of constructive deliberations in the administrative hall at Chacha town.

The approved budget prioritizes three major socioeconomic pillars: the expansion of deep water borehole schemes across 6 moisture-stressed kebeles, the upgrade of 45 kilometers of community feeder roads connecting farming villages to the main A2 highway, and modernization subsidies for local agricultural cooperatives.

Chief Administrator of the Woreda, in his address to council members, underscored that fiscal transparency, timely project completion, and strict monitoring of public expenditure will remain the uncompromising standards of the executive cabinet.

content_en: The Angolela Tera Woreda Agriculture and Rural Development Office has officially launched the mass distribution of certified agricultural inputs across all kebele multipurpose union service stations.

The input package focuses on the highly productive, stripe rust-resistant bread wheat varieties suitable for highland elevations above 2,600 meters, ensuring optimal grain yields even during fluctuating seasonal rain patterns.

Field development agents (DAs) are actively providing localized technical demonstrations on cluster farming, balanced fertilizer application, and mechanized sowing techniques to ensure farmers achieve maximum productivity.
